description: Summarize how Raven has been used on this machine over the last N days. Reports which tools are called most, which audit warnings fire repeatedly (→ likely gaps in Raven's knowledge), which patterns and design systems you look up, and which companies you ask for brand styles. Call this when the user asks 'what have I been building with Raven' or 'what's Raven missing'. All data is read from a local log ($RAVEN_USAGE_LOG or ~/.raven/usage.jsonl) — nothing is fetched over the network.

days.description: How many days back to include. Default: 30.

name: raven_reflect
